project_type: Nuxt 4 fullstack app (Vue 3 <script setup lang=ts> SFCs + Nitro server). Internal NetOps Policy Manager — previews device commands, delegates execution to n8n, never pushes config.
build_system: Nuxt 4 (nuxt build). No bundler quirks beyond standard Nuxt. postinstall runs `nuxt prepare`.
test_framework: Vitest is a devDependency but there is NO vitest.config and NO test files; `npm test` runs `vitest run --passWithNoTests`. Per design N3, NO unit tests and NO vitest config are added in this task.
test_command: npm run typecheck   (the authoritative check per design N3; then `npm run build`)
verification_instructions: The USER runs all commands (AGENTS.md). After edits, run `npm run typecheck` (expect 0 errors) then `npm run build` (expect success). The app must boot with ITOP_DATABASE_URL unset (design R17). Clean up any temp files. No live iTop DB is required to pass typecheck/build.
snapshot_or_generated_files: None. No DB migration (iTop is a foreign read-only MariaDB, NOT part of the Drizzle schema; no app DB schema changes).
environment_constraints: The USER runs all terminal commands (build/typecheck/install/git) — the coder gives exact commands and continues from results, never assumes a command ran. mysql2 is NOT yet a dependency; it must be added to package.json and the user runs `npm install`. Never read or commit .env. Never log/echo secrets (ITOP_DATABASE_URL, N8N_API_KEY, passwords, TOTP). iTop access is READ-ONLY (SELECT only) — never issue write/DDL.
contribution_requirements: AGENTS.md: answer to the point; user runs all commands; match existing patterns and read files before editing; keep changes scoped; never weaken security or leak secrets; keep docs in sync (.kiro/specs). Zod is the source of truth (shared/schemas, z.infer, no parallel interfaces). Layering: thin handler -> assertSameOrigin -> auth -> Zod validate -> service -> network client -> DB; never return raw DB rows. Envelope {success,data}/{success,error:{code,message,fields?}} via server/utils/envelope.ts. RBAC is data-driven via requirePermission(event, PERMISSIONS.X); never branch on role id. UI (ui-conventions.md): Nuxt UI + Tailwind v4 token classes only (bg-panel, border-line, text-ink, text-muted, bg-brand, text-ok/text-bad); Lucide i-lucide-* icons; force light UInput look with color=neutral variant=outline :ui base bg-panel text-ink ring-line placeholder:text-muted; primary button bg-brand text-white; icon-only buttons need aria-label; wrap fields in shared FormField (do NOT restyle it); use shared LoadingState/EmptyState/ErrorState.
key_patterns: Handler imports are EXPLICIT relative paths (NOT Nitro auto-imports); server/api/itop/tickets/*.post.ts is THREE levels below server/ (../../../utils, ../../../services, ../../../network), server/api/{itop,n8n}/test.post.ts is TWO levels (../../utils, ../../network). Schema types import via the #shared alias (#shared/schemas/itop.schema, #shared/constants/rbac). Reference handler: server/api/acl/show.post.ts. Network-client pattern (lazy pool/fetch, timeout-bounded, NEVER throws credential-bearing errors): server/network/n8n-client.ts. Modal pattern: app/components/DeviceCredentialsModal.vue (UModal). The 4 ACL/Route pages are near-identical: reactive form, buildPayload() ending in `as *Input` cast (MUST be removed), watch(form) that nulls preview/result/warning, resetFields() after success, native <button :disabled=...> Generate (v-if=!preview) vs Execute (v-else). envelope.ts ErrorCode is a string-literal union. config.ts EnvSchema is ONE z.object({...}).refine(...) — insert new keys inside the object BEFORE the closing `})` that precedes .refine; no runtimeConfig anywhere, config read only via loadEnv(). useApi() returns grouped method objects; apiGet unwraps GET envelope, apiSend for POST/PATCH/DELETE.

directory_structure: shared/schemas/ = Zod source of truth (client+server). server/network/ = thin external clients (n8n-client.ts; new itop-client.ts). server/services/ = business logic + mapping to Zod response shapes. server/api/<module>/<action>.<method>.ts = thin Nitro handlers. server/utils/ = envelope.ts, config.ts, auth.ts, db.ts. app/pages/ = routed SFCs ({acl,routes}/{add,delete}.vue, administration/index.vue). app/components/ = shared components (FormField, LoadingState, EmptyState, ErrorState, DeviceCredentialsModal, Pagination, ConfirmDialog). app/composables/useApi.ts = envelope-unwrapping client. .kiro/specs/ = EARS specs to keep in sync.
